package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

// chan/select2's shape: runtime.MemStats allocated with new, filled by
// runtime.ReadMemStats through the pointer, then read field by field.
func main() {
	memstats := new(runtime.MemStats)
	runtime.ReadMemStats(memstats)
	alloc := memstats.Alloc
	fmt.Println(alloc > 0, memstats.Sys >= memstats.HeapSys, memstats.Mallocs >= memstats.Frees)
	before := memstats.Mallocs
	runtime.ReadMemStats(memstats)
	fmt.Println(memstats.Mallocs >= before, len(memstats.BySize), memstats.NumGC >= 0)
	// Positive control: the variable spelling reads its fields directly.
	var direct runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&direct)
	fmt.Println(direct.Sys > 0, direct.HeapSys <= direct.Sys)
}
